maya: :rotating_light: customer reported wide 502/504 spike from hosted API (eu1) after a billing token rotation at ~14:03 UTC. they sent large streaming requests (long-poll) and started seeing immediate edge failures.
jon: which traces? any common trace-id or backend?
maya: put one in ticket: trace=trc-0a1b2c3d, sample curl below. errors look like upstream early close and h2 reset  :confused:
kevin: can you paste the curl? also which cluster (frontdoor/lb/midproxy)?
maya: curl -v -H "Authorization: Bearer <token>" -H "X-Tenant: acme-corp" "https://eu1.api.redwood.ai/v1/stream"
kevin: repro'd locally with short script — saw connection reset after ~7s on stream start. logs show envoy upstream close (HTTP/2: RST_STREAM) and nginx 502 from midproxy. suspect: keepalive window mismatch + concurrent auth-fanout spike after token rotate.
lina: saw similar last month — auth cache misses cause fanout to auth backends which temporarily blocks the edge keepalive pool. if keepalive exhaustion + upstream RST you get 502s for long streams.
maya: mitigation applied: increased edge keepalive pool for eu1 and temporarily pinned auth key to previous KID for affected tenant (rollback token) :thumbsup: immediate drop in 502 rate.
jon: can we get an automated fallback: if auth backend latency spikes >100ms, route tenant to warm auth cache or short-circuit with cached principal? also add alert for keepalive pool saturation.
kevin: added a short-term dashboard tile and an alert rule (edge.keepalive.pool.usage > 80% for 1m). filed infra ticket INF-4021 to add auth fallback logic.
deploy-bot: deploy started: edge-keepalive-increase-eu1 v2 -> canary
maya: follow-up: collect more traces + sample requests from impacted customer and add to reproducer. create a playbook step for pinning KID rollback and keepalive bump.
kevin: I'll draft the runbook, add curl repro and an nginx/envoy log sample in the ticket.
lina: tagging oncall @jon for post-mortem tomorrow. good catch on auth-fanout + keepalive interaction.
maya: thanks all — closing this thread, will update ticket with timeline and mitigations. :white_check_mark:
